recipes.name: 1934 Cosmo
recipes.desc: 换个对味的基酒，简单酸酒也能完全变样。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰用力摇 20 秒
3. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯
4. 以橙皮 twists 装饰
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice and shake hard for 20 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled coupe
4. Garnish with an orange twist
recipes.descEn: A simple sour can be so different with the right base spirit.

recipes.name: 2 to 2
recipes.desc: 一杯苦甜交织的鸡尾酒，比它的配料表看起来更好接近。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰用力摇 10 秒
3. 滤入冰镇杯中
4. 以橙皮装饰
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled glass
4. Garnish with an orange peel
recipes.descEn: A bittersweet cocktail that's more accessible than its ingredient list may suggest.

recipes.name: 20th Century
recipes.desc: 1937 年由英国调酒师 C.A. 创制，名字致敬 20 世纪初的巴黎。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰放入摇壶摇匀
2. 滤入浅碟杯，不加冰上桌
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients with ice and shake
2. Strain into a coupe, serve up
recipes.descEn: The 20th Century is a cocktail created in 1937 by a British bartender named C.A.

recipes.desc: 212 是一杯装在大号漂亮红粉杯里的可口鸡尾酒。
steps: 1. 所有材料在摇壶中混合摇匀
2. 双滤入装满冰的大号冰镇杯
3. 可选补入苏打水
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a shaker and shake
2. Double strain into large, chilled glass filled with ice.
3. Optionally top with soda.
recipes.descEn: The 212 is a delectable cocktail in a big, beautiful, reddish-pink package.
recipes.garnishEn: grapefruit peel or orange peel for garnish

recipes.name: 21st and 1/4 Century
recipes.desc: 这是 20th Century 的变体，用椰子朗姆替代金酒，替换得天衣无缝。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰入摇壶，摇至冰镇
2. 滤入杯中，再装饰
stepsEn: 1. Add all of the ingredients to the shaker with ice and shake to chill.
2. Strain into a glass, then garnish.
recipes.descEn: This twist on the 20th Century cocktail uses coconut rum as a stand-in for gin, a sub that works seamlessly…

recipes.name: 8 Amaro Sazerac
recipes.desc: Mayur Subbarao 在 2011 年为曼哈顿 Amor y Amargo 的开业菜单创作了这份配方。
steps: 加冰搅拌，滤入用绿查特酒预洗过的古典杯，以柠檬 twists 装饰。
stepsEn: Stir with ice, strain into a rocks glass pre-rinsed with Green Chartreuse, and garnish with a lemon twist.
recipes.descEn: Mayur Subbarao created this recipe for the opening menu at Manhattan's Amor y Amargo in 2011, and it has…

recipes.name: A.S. Kingston Negroni
recipes.desc: 金斯顿尼格罗尼：用 oloroso 雪莉酒浸出咖啡豆风味的经典组合。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯，搅拌至冷
2. 偶尔尝味，确保咖啡豆风味已融入酒中
3. 滤入装大冰块的古典杯
4. 以半片橙轮和青柠 twists 装饰
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice and stir until chilled.
2. Taste occasionally to ensure the coffee bean flavor has infused the drink.
3. Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
4. Garnish with a half orange wheel and lime twist.
recipes.descEn: A Kingston Negroni cocktail recipe that stirs the classic mix of rum, Campari and sweet vermouth with oloroso…

recipes.name: Absent Stars
recipes.desc: 新派热带朗姆鸡尾酒，Passionfruit 与西柚风味饱满。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰用力摇 20 秒
3. 滤入冰镇古典杯
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice and shake hard for 20 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled rocks glass
recipes.descEn: A nouveau tropical rum cocktail with big passionfruit and grapefruit flavor.

recipes.name: Absinthe Colada
recipes.desc: 薄荷与椰子是天作之合，却在鸡尾酒里被低估了。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰用力摇 10 秒
3. 滤入装碎冰的飓风杯
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds
3. Strain into a hurricane glass filled with crushed ice
recipes.descEn: Mint and coconut are an excellent pairing that's underused in cocktails.

recipes.name: Absinthe Frappé
recipes.desc: 梦幻的经典款，让苦艾酒变得亲和且出人意料地清爽。
steps: 1. 糖浆与苦艾酒在装冰的摇壶中混合
3. 滤入装碎冰的冰镇杯
stepsEn: 1. Combine syrup and absinthe in a shaker filled with ice
2. Shake for 10 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled glass filled with crushed ice
recipes.descEn: A dreamy classic that makes absinthe approachable and surprisingly refreshing.

recipes.name: Absinthe Old Fashioned
recipes.desc: 路易斯维尔 Rye 餐厅的 Doug Petry 设计的苦艾酒版古典。
steps: 1. 除苦精外所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯
2. 搅拌 20 秒，滤入装冰的古典杯
3. 表面淋几滴苦精形成分层
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients except bitters to a mixing glass with ice
2. Stir 20 seconds and strain into a rocks glass filled with ice
3. Dash bitters on top to layer
recipes.descEn: Doug Petry of Louisville’s Rye restaurant devised this absinthe-based old fashioned.

recipes.name: Adonis
recipes.desc: 这款鸡尾酒为致敬 1884 年的音乐剧《Adonis》而作。
steps: 所有材料加冰搅拌，滤入冰镇杯中。
stepsEn: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into chilled glass.
recipes.descEn: The cocktail was created in honor of the 1884 musical Adonis after the show reached the milestone of more…

recipes.name: Affinity
recipes.desc: 这款冷门经典最初用等量的苏格兰威士忌、干味美思调制。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰搅拌至冷
2. 滤入冰镇杯中
stepsEn: 1. Stir all of the ingredients with ice to chill
2. Strain into a chilled glass
recipes.descEn: This off-the-radar classic cocktail was originally made with equal measures of Scotch whisky, dry vermouth,…

recipes.name: After All Imperial
recipes.desc: 轻盈气泡经典款的果味改编。
steps: 1. 除起泡酒外所有材料在摇壶中混合摇匀
2. 滤入柯林杯或长笛杯，补入起泡酒
3. 以薄荷或迷迭香装饰
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients, except sparkling wine, in a shaker and shake.
2. Strain into a collins glass or flute and top with sparkling wine.
3. Garnish with mint or rosemary
recipes.descEn: A fruity spin on a light, bubbly classic
recipes.garnishEn: Sprig mint or rosemary for garnish

recipes.name: Airmail
recipes.desc: 一杯喝不完的起泡酒，来历众说纷纭。
steps: 1. 除香槟外所有材料在调酒壶中混合摇 10 秒
2. 滤入长笛杯，补入香槟
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients except for the champagne in a mixer and shake for ten seconds
2. Strain into a flute and top with champagne
recipes.descEn: An endlessly drinkable sparkler of debated origin

recipes.name: Alabazam
recipes.desc: 最古老的酸酒之一，用到了惊人的大量安高天娜苦精。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰混合摇匀
2. 滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯，不加冰上桌
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients with ice and shake
2. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, serve up
recipes.descEn: One of the oldest sours, this drink also uses an enormous portion of Angostura bitters

recipes.name: Alaska
recipes.desc: 查特酒家族最伟大的鸡尾酒之一，也是最基础的三味配方。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯，长时间搅拌至杯身结霜
2. 滤入鸡尾酒杯，不加冰上桌
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients with ice in a mixing glass and stir at length, until the sides of the glass are frosty
2. Strain into a cocktail glass and serve up
recipes.descEn: One of the great Chartreuse cocktails and a fundamental three-ingredient recipe

recipes.name: Alexander
recipes.desc: 1922 年诞生于伦敦 Ciro's Club，由 Hery McElhone 为致敬一位名流而调制。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入装满冰块的摇壶
2. 摇匀后滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
stepsEn: 1. Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes.
2. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: The Alexander cocktail was born in London in 1922 by Hery Mc Elhone, at Ciro’s Club in honor of a famous…

recipes.name: Algonquin
recipes.desc: 以曼哈顿中城的一家历史酒店命名，经典配方用黑麦威士忌调制。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰摇匀，细滤入冰镇杯中。
stepsEn: 1. Shake all ingredients with ice and fine strain into chilled glass.
recipes.descEn: Named for a historic hotel in midtown Manhattan, the classic Algonquin cocktail combines rye whiskey,…

recipes.name: Amalfi Frappe
recipes.desc: Little Rituals 的老板 Ross Simon 想用这杯 frozzy 捕捉阿马尔菲海岸的风味。
recipes.garnish: 柠檬皮屑与茴香花（可选）
steps: 1. 材料在杯中混合，加入刨冰轻搅融合
2. 再补刨冰并装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine the ingredients in a glass, then add shaved ice and stir briefly to incorporate.
2. Top with more shaved ice and garnish.
recipes.descEn: For this frappe, Little Rituals owner Ross Simon wanted to capture the flavors of the Amalfi Coast.

recipes.name: Amaretto Sour
recipes.desc: Amaretto 是意大利杏仁或杏核风味的利口酒。
recipes.garnish: 用喷壶在泡沫上喷少许芳香苦精，配柠檬与樱桃装饰
steps: 1. 所有材料混合；如用蛋清则干摇
2. 加冰摇 10 秒
3. 滤入杯中
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients and, if using an egg white, dry shake
2. Add ice and shake for 10 sec
3. Strain into a glass
recipes.descEn: Amaretto is an Italian liqueur that’s typically flavored with almonds or apricot stones.
recipes.garnishEn: Spray aromatic bitters over foaming cocktail from atomiser and then garnish with lemon & cherry sail (lemon slice & Luxardo Maraschino cherry on stick)

recipes.name: Amaretto Sour (Jeffrey Morgenthaler)
recipes.desc: 有两件事让其他所有 Amaretto Sour 都无法挑战我的版本。
recipes.garnish: 以柠檬皮与酒渍樱桃装饰
steps: 1. 材料在摇壶中混合，不加冰摇匀（或更好：用料理棒搅打出泡沫）
2. 加碎冰充分摇匀
3. 滤入装新鲜冰块的古典杯
stepsEn: 1. Combine ingredients in a cocktail shaker and shake without ice or (even better) use an immersion blender to combine and froth.
2. Shake well with cracked ice.
3. Strain over fresh ice in an old fashioned glass
recipes.descEn: There are two things that impede all other Amaretto Sours from challenging mine.
recipes.garnishEn: Garnish with lemon peel and brandied cherries.

recipes.name: Amaro Highball
recipes.desc: Julep Houston 调酒师 David Kubiak 用它来突出 Amaro Montenegro。
steps: 1. 除苏打水外所有材料加冰入摇壶
2. 摇匀后滤入装冰的杯中
3. 补入苏打水
stepsEn: 1. Add all of the ingredients, except the soda water, to a shaker filled with ice.
2. Shake and then strain into an ice-filled glass.
3. Top with the soda.
recipes.descEn: Julep Houston bartender David Kubiak created this amaro highball to highlight Amaro Montenegro and serve as…

recipes.name: Amen Corner
recipes.desc: 由 PDT 校友 Nick Brown 创作，是经典 Paper Plane 的波本版变体。
steps: 1. 在调酒壶中轻轻捣压薄荷
2. 其余材料倒入调酒壶加冰摇匀
3. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯
4. 以酒渍樱桃装饰
stepsEn: 1. Gently muddle the mint in a mixing tin.
2. Combine remaining ingredients in the mixing tin and shake with ice.
3. Strain into a chilled coupe.
4. Garnish with brandied cherries.
recipes.descEn: Created by PDT alum Nick Brown, the bourbon-based cocktail recipe is a riff on the classic Paper Plane…

recipes.name: Americano
recipes.desc: 故事可追溯到 19 世纪后半叶米兰 Gaspare Campari 的酒吧。
steps: 1. 所有材料直接倒入装满冰块的古典杯
2. 补少量苏打水
3. 轻轻搅拌
stepsEn: 1. Mix the ingredients directly in an old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
2. Add a splash of Soda Water.
3. Stir gently.
recipes.descEn: The story of the Americano dates back to the second half of the 1800s in Gaspare Campari’s bar in Milan.
recipes.garnishEn: Garnish with half orange slice and a lemon zest.

recipes.name: Amoxicillin
recipes.desc: 经典 Penicillin 用 3/4 盎司蜂蜜姜糖浆，这版改用黄色……
steps: 1. 除泥煤威士忌外所有材料倒入调酒壶加冰摇匀
2. 滤入装冰的古典杯
3. 最后用喷壶喷六下泥煤威士忌
4. 以柠檬轮装饰
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients, except the peated Scotch, in a mixing tin and shake with ice.
2. Strain into a rocks glass over ice.
3. Finish with six sprays of peated Scotch from an atomizer.
4. Garnish with a lemon wheel.
recipes.descEn: Unlike the classic Penicillin, which calls for ¾ ounce honey-ginger syrup, this cocktail recipe uses yellow…

recipes.name: Ancho Problem
recipes.desc: 回应「来点辣的、配龙舌兰」的需求，Ezra Star 调制出这款辣椒与 blanco……
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰摇匀
2. 滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯。
stepsEn: 1. Shake all ingredients with ice.
2. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: In response to the request for "something spicy, with tequila," Ezra Star whips up this chile- and blanco…

recipes.name: Andalusian Buck
recipes.desc: 这杯好在哪？它哪个方向都不走过头。
steps: 1. 金酒、雪莉酒、青柠汁与德梅拉拉糖浆加冰倒入摇壶
2. 摇至冷
3. 我喜欢把姜汁啤酒直接加进摇壶，再缓缓倒入装新鲜冰的冰镇柯林杯。
stepsEn: 1. Combine gin, sherry, lime juice, and Demerara syrup in a cocktail shaker with ice.
2. Shake until cold.
3. I like to add the ginger beer directly to the shaker, then pour slowly over fresh ice in a chilled Collins glass.
recipes.descEn: This drink is great because it doesn’t go too far any any direction.

recipes.name: Angel Face
recipes.desc: 起源已不可考，主流说法认为它诞生于 1920 年代。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入装满冰块的摇壶
2. 摇匀后滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
stepsEn: 1. Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes.
2. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: Although the origin of the cocktail is not known, the main hypotheses assume that it was born in the twenties…

recipes.name: Angie
recipes.desc: 2017 年在巴拿马旅行时，Dear Strangers 首席调酒师 Bratislav Glisic 创作了它。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰入摇壶，摇至冷后滤入杯中，装饰。
百香果糖浆：1 杯百香果泥加 1 杯细砂糖在锅中煮沸，冷却后过滤。冷藏可存 2 周。
stepsEn: 1. Add all of the ingredients to a shaker with ice. Shake to chill, then strain into the glass. Garnish.
Passion Fruit SyrupCombine 1 cup of passion fruit purée and 1 cup of superfine sugar in a pot and boil. Allow to cool, then strain. Will keep in the refrigerator for 2 weeks.
recipes.descEn: During a visit to Panama in 2017, Bratislav Glisic, head bartender and co-founder of Dear Strangers in New…
recipes.garnishEn: Matcha powder and dehydrated lime wheel

recipes.name: Anna’s Revenge
recipes.desc: 布鲁克林 Bar Camillo 以苦味见长，首席调酒师 Anna Wang 因此创作了它。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰入摇壶，摇匀后滤入杯中，装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Add all of the ingredients to a shaker with ice. Shake and then strain into the glass. Garnish.
recipes.descEn: Since Brooklyn's Bar Camillo features a range of bitter-forward cocktails, head bartender Anna Wang sought to…

recipes.name: Apapacho Café
recipes.desc: 来自 Rosewood Mayakoba 的 Zapote Bar（北美 50 佳酒吧之一）的经典爱尔兰咖啡变体。
steps: 1. 前 4 种材料倒入杯中轻搅。奶油加一块冰倒入摇壶，用力摇打。滤在酒上，再磨肉豆蔻撒在表面。
2. 注：酒吧会在装饰时把 pinole 与肉豆蔻按 4:1 混合，但没有 pinole 的话单用肉豆蔻也完全可以。
stepsEn: 1. Pour the first 4 ingredients into the glass and gently stir. Add the whipping cream to a shaker with an ice cube and shake very hard. Strain over the cocktail, then grate the nutmeg over the top.
2. Note: The bar mixes a bit of pinole with nutmeg (4:1) for the garnish, but nutmeg alone works fine if you don’t have pinole.
recipes.descEn: This twist on classic Irish coffee from Rosewood Mayakoba's Zapote Bar, one of the 50 Best Bars in North…

recipes.name: APB Melrose Gin & Tonic
recipes.desc: 洛杉矶 APB（A Plant Bar）Melrose 的这杯蓝色金汤力，灵感来自蓝色查雷酒。
recipes.garnish: 薄柠檬轮、紫罗兰小花（可选）
steps: 1. 前 4 种材料加冰入摇壶，摇至冷，滤入装新鲜冰块的杯中。加入汤力水，铺上 pebble ice，最后沿边淋入蓝色 Chareau。装饰。
2. 蓝色 Chareau：每 1/2 杯 Chareau 加 1/8 茶匙蓝藻粉，打匀。冷藏可存 2 周。
stepsEn: 1. Add the first 4 ingredients to a shaker with ice. Shake until chilled, then strain into a glass over fresh ice. Add the tonic, top with pebble ice, then drizzle the blue Chareau on top. Garnish.
2. Blue ChareauAnd 1/8 tsp. of blue spirulina to 1/2 cup Chareau and whisk. Will keep in the refrigerator for 2 weeks.
recipes.descEn: This mesmerizingly azure-topped gin and tonic from Los Angeles' APB (A Plant Bar) Melrose draws inspiration…

recipes.name: Aperol Spritz
recipes.desc: Spritz 是威尼斯的基酒型鸡尾酒，在意大利东北部常作开胃酒。
steps: 所有材料直接兑入装满冰的葡萄酒杯，轻轻搅匀
stepsEn: Build all ingredients into a wine glass filled with ice. Stir gently.
recipes.descEn: A Spritz is a Venetian wine-based cocktail, commonly served as an aperitif in Northeast Italy.
recipes.garnishEn: Garnish with a slice of orange.

recipes.name: Appetizer à l’Italienne
recipes.desc: 被遗忘的鸡尾酒与被爱的经典之间，差别也许只是分量。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰搅拌，滤入冰镇杯中。在酒面上挤出 twists 的精油，并用作装饰。
2. Tip Schmidt 在 1892 年的书中没有为这杯指定装饰，但 Yarm 说柠檬 twists「能柔化 Fernet 的冲劲，橙皮 twists 则可以让味道更甜。
stepsEn: 1. Stir all of the ingredients with ice, then strain into a chilled glass. Express the twists over the finished cocktail, and use as a garnish.

2. Tip Schmidt didn’t specify a garnish for the drink in his 1892 book, but Yarm says a lemon twist “would smooth out the fernet’s aggression, and an orange twist to sweeten things would be nice, too.
recipes.descEn: It could be argued that the difference between a forgotten cocktail and a beloved classic is simply the size…

recipes.name: Apple Amaretto Sour
recipes.desc: Anders 版的 Amaretto Sour 秋季变体。
recipes.garnish: 挤出柠檬精油，配鸡尾酒樱桃
steps: 摇匀
stepsEn: Shake
recipes.descEn: Autumn variation of Amaretto Sour by Anders
recipes.garnishEn: Express lemon oils, add cocktail cherry

recipes.name: Apple Kickin'
recipes.desc: 大胆、微苦的古典变体，风味层次是新鲜苹果的……
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入装大冰块的古典杯
2. 搅拌 20 秒
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a rocks glass with a large format ice cube
2. Stir for 20 seconds
recipes.descEn: A bold, lightly bitter Old Fashioned variant whose flavor profile is an intriguing blend of fresh apple…

recipes.name: Apples All the Way Down
recipes.desc: 几滴苦精与新鲜迷迭香平衡了这款明亮高球酒的甜，满满秋意。
steps: 1. 糖浆、柠檬与白兰地倒入装冰的高球杯
2. 补入苹果酒并搅拌
3. 轻拍迷迭香枝释放精油后装饰
stepsEn: 1. Add syrup, lemon, and brandy to a highball glass filled with ice
2. Top with cider and stir
3. Slap a sprig of rosemary to release its oils and garnish
recipes.descEn: A dash of bitters and fresh rosemary balance the sweetness of this bright highball that's brimming with fall…

recipes.name: Apricot and Coffee Highball
recipes.desc: 杏与咖啡看似不搭，但在俄勒冈 Too Soon 酒吧，这个想法……
steps: 1. 前 4 种材料倒入装冰的杯中搅拌融合
2. 补入汤力水，然后装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Add the first 4 ingredients to the ice-filled glass and stir to combine.
2. Top with tonic water, then garnish.
recipes.descEn: Apricot and coffee might not seem like an obvious flavor duo, but at Too Soon in Portland, Oregon, the idea…

recipes.name: Apèro Spritz
steps: 1. 前 4 种材料加冰倒入调酒壶，短促摇匀
2. 双滤入装碎冰的葡萄酒杯，补入普罗塞克
3. 有红醋栗就用红醋栗，没有就用柠檬角
stepsEn: 1. Add first four ingredients to a shaker tin with ice and short shake.
2. Double strain into a wine glass over cracked clear ice and top with prosecco.
3. Garnish with red currants if you have them, lemon wedge if you don’t

recipes.name: Archangel
recipes.desc: Pink Gin 的衍生版，把黄瓜的香气与橙皮的……巧妙结合。
steps: 1. 调酒杯中用捣棒拍压黄瓜片
2. 加入金酒、Aperol 与冰，搅拌至冷
3. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯或鸡尾酒杯
4. 以柠檬皮装饰
stepsEn: 1. In a mixing glass, bruise cucumber slices with a muddler.
2. Add gin, Aperol, ice and stir until chilled.
3. Strain into a chilled coupe or cocktail glass.
4. Garnish with a lemon peel.
recipes.descEn: A play on a Pink Gin, the Archangel cocktail recipe combines the aromatic subtlety of cucumbers, the orange…

recipes.name: Army & Navy
recipes.desc: Army & Navy 是一杯热带风味金酒鸡尾酒，用金酒、柠檬汁、杏仁露与安高天娜苦精调制。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰倒入摇壶，摇至冷
2. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯或鸡尾酒杯。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice and shake until chilled.
2. Strain into a chilled coupe or cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: The Army & Navy is a tropical gin cocktail recipe made with gin, lemon juice, orgeat and Angostura bitters.

recipes.name: Arrowhead Limited
recipes.desc: Damon Boelte 热衷于把啤酒与苦精搭配，于是用 IPA 给这杯「梅斯卡尔尼格罗尼」收尾。
steps: 1. 金巴利、梅斯卡尔与 Carpano Antica 倒入高球杯
2. 加冰，补入 IPA
3. 以西柚片装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Add Campari, mezcal and Carpano Antica to a high ball glass.
2. Add ice, and top with IPA.
3. Garnish with grapefruit slices.
recipes.descEn: Ever a lover of combining beer with bitters, Damon Boelte tops this "mezcal Negroni" cocktail recipe with IPA.

recipes.name: Arsenic and Old Lace
recipes.desc: Arsenic and Old Lace 是一款用金酒、苦艾酒、干味美思与奶油利口酒调制的马天尼。
steps: 1. 用喷壶在冰镇浅碟杯中喷上苦艾酒
2. 其余材料在调酒杯中加冰搅拌
3. 滤入备好的杯中
4. 在酒面挤出柠檬 twists 的精油，并作装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Using an atomizer, spritz a chilled coupe glass with absinthe.
2. Combine all other ingredients in a mixing glass and stir with ice.
3. Strain into prepared glass.
4. Express a lemon twist over the drink, then use as garnish.
recipes.descEn: The Arsenic and Old Lace is a Martini cocktail recipe made with gin, absinthe, dry vermouth, crème de…

recipes.name: Art of Choke
recipes.desc: 2008 年 Kyle Davidson 灵光一现调出这杯，彻底打破了所有规则。
steps: 1. 调酒杯中捣压薄荷与糖浆
2. 加入其余材料与冰，搅拌 20 秒
3. 滤入装新鲜冰的冰镇古典杯
stepsEn: 1. Muddle mint and syrup in a mixing glass
2. Add remaining with ice and stir for 20 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled rocks glass with fresh ice
recipes.descEn: A drink that broke all the rules when Kyle Davidson first conjured it in 2008.

recipes.name: Artichoke Hold
recipes.desc: Smith & Cross 朗姆的温暖发酵味为苦艾与……的苦甜交融打下厚重基底。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加少量冰轻摇
3. 滤入装碎冰的古典杯
4. 再补碎冰。
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker.
2. Add a small amount of ice and shake lightly.
3. Strain over crushed ice into a rocks glass.
4. Top with more crushed ice.
recipes.descEn: The warm funk of Smith & Cross rum creates a heavy base for the bittersweet co-mingling of amaro and…

recipes.name: Aspen Crud
recipes.desc: 禁酒令时期诞生于 Hotel Jerome，Aspen Crud 是这座滑雪小镇前浮华时代的象征。
steps: 1. 波本与冰淇淋放入搅拌机，打至顺滑奶油状
2. 倒入品脱杯或梅森罐，用了樱桃就装饰，配吸管上桌。
stepsEn: 1. Add bourbon and ice cream to a blender and blitz until creamy.
2. Pour into a pint glass or Mason jar and garnish with cherries, if using. Serve with a straw.
recipes.descEn: Invented at Hotel Jerome during Prohibition, the Aspen Crud cocktail is a symbol of the ski town's pre-glitz…

recipes.name: Assunta
recipes.desc: Saint Theo 的每杯酒都向意大利的名字、食材或装饰致意，饮品总监……
steps: 1. 除姜汁啤酒外所有材料加冰入摇壶，用力摇匀。倒入装碎冰的高球杯，补入姜汁啤酒，装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Add the ingredients, except the ginger beer, to a shaker with ice and shake vigorously. Pour into a highball filled with crushed ice and top with ginger beer, then garnish.
recipes.descEn: Since every cocktail at Saint Theo's is a nod to an Italian name, ingredient, or garnish, beverage director…

recipes.name: Autoretrato
recipes.desc: Autoretrato 是对现代经典 Amaretto Sour 的热带改编，为另一群听众重新设计。
recipes.garnish: 薄荷叶、干三叶草花、半颗百香果
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 干摇使蛋清乳化
3. 加冰摇至冷
4. 双滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
5. 以半颗百香果、薄荷叶与干三叶草花装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all of the ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
2. Dry shake to emulsify the egg whites.
3. Add ice and shake until chilled.
4. Double strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
5. Garnish with a half of passion fruit, mint leaf and a dried clover blossom.
recipes.descEn: Autoretrato is a tropical riff on the modern classic Amaretto Sour, reinvented for a different audience.
recipes.garnishEn: Mint leaf, dried clover blossom, half of passion fruit

recipes.name: Avenue Scotch
recipes.desc: 来自严寒冰岛的一杯热带酸酒。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰用力摇 10 秒
3. 滤入冰镇尼格诺拉杯
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled Nick & Nora glass
recipes.descEn: From frigid Iceland comes this tropical sour.

recipes.name: Aviation
recipes.desc: 由 Walkick 酒店首席调酒师 Hugo Ensslin 创制。
steps: 1. 所有材料加入摇壶
2. 加碎冰摇匀，滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker.
2. Shake with cracked ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: Aviation was created in New York at the Walkick hotel by the head bartender Hugo Ensslin while he was writing…

recipes.name: B-52
recipes.desc: B-52 的来历没有可靠记载，但有一种说法是它由 Peter Fich 发明……
steps: 先把材料冷藏，再按顺序小心倒入冰镇杯中分层。
stepsEn: Refrigerate ingredients then layer in chilled glass by carefully pouring in the ingredient order.
recipes.descEn: The origins of the B-52 are not well documented, but one claim is that the B-52 was invented by Peter Fich, a…

recipes.name: Baby Turtle
recipes.desc: 龙舌兰鸡尾酒，用龙舌兰、金巴利、西柚与青柠汁、肉桂糖浆调制。
steps: 1. 所有材料入摇壶干摇（不加冰）融合
2. 加冰摇至冷
3. 双滤入装冰的双份古典杯。
stepsEn: 1. Add all of the ingredients to a shaker and dry-shake (without ice) to combine.
2. Add ice to the shaker and shake until chilled.
3. Double-strain into a double Old-Fashioned glass over ice.
recipes.descEn: A tequila cocktail recipe that combines reposado tequila, Campari, grapefruit and lime juice, cinnamon syrup…

recipes.name: Bacardi Cocktail
recipes.desc: Bacardí Cocktail 最初与 Daiquiri 相同，含朗姆、青柠汁与糖。
steps: 加冰一起摇匀，滤入杯中上桌。
stepsEn: Shake together with ice. Strain into glass and serve
recipes.descEn: The Bacardí Cocktail was originally the same as the Daiquiri, containing rum, lime juice, and sugar; The…

recipes.name: Backlash & Tonic
recipes.desc: 这杯简单的开胃酒有着来自墨尔本 Pendant Public Bar 的多层风味。
steps: 1. 所有材料放入装大冰块的杯中轻搅融合，装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all of the ingredients in a glass with a large ice cube and briefly stir to combine, and garnish.
recipes.descEn: This simple aperitivo cocktail offers layers of flavor from Melbourne's Pendant Public Bar.

recipes.name: Backsliding Presbyterian
recipes.desc: 高挑、充满苦甜橙与姜香，这杯威士忌高球证明陈年烈酒……
steps: 除苏打水外所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入装冰的杯中。补入苏打水并装饰。
stepsEn: Shake all ingredients (except club soda) with ice and strain into an ice-filled glass. Top with club soda and garnish.
recipes.descEn: Tall and bursting with bittersweet orange and ginger flavors, this whiskey highball proves that aged spirits…

recipes.name: Bahama Mama
recipes.desc: 提基大师 Paul McGee 重新校准了这杯经典配方的比例。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入调酒壶，加 5 块冰摇 5 秒
2. 滤入装碎冰的飓风杯
3. 以热带水果装饰。

ings.note: preferably Rum-Bar Overproof White Jamaican Rum

stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing tin. Add 5 ice cubes and shake for 5 seconds.
2. Strain into a Hurricane glass filled with crushed ice.
3. Garnish with tropical fruit.
recipes.descEn: Tiki master Paul McGee’s recalibrated version of this classic cocktail recipe involves dialing down the…

recipes.name: Baltimore Southside
recipes.desc: 向巴尔的摩黑人调酒师传承致敬的 Southside。
recipes.garnish: 薄荷束、柠檬轮或脱水柠檬轮
steps: 1. 朗姆、柠檬汁、基础糖浆与薄荷加冰入摇壶
2. 摇至冷
3. 滤入装 1.25 英寸冰块的双份古典杯
4. 补入约 1.5 盎司苏打水
5. 以薄荷与柠檬轮装饰。

ings.note: such as Don Q Cristal or El Dorado 3-year

stepsEn: 1. Combine the rum, lemon juice, simple syrup and mint in a shaker with ice.
2. Shake until chilled.
3. Strain into a double rocks glass over 1.25-inch ice cubes.
4. Top with about 1 1/2 ounces of club soda.
5. Garnish with mint and a lemon wheel.
recipes.descEn: A Southside that honors the legacy of Baltimore's Black bartenders.
recipes.garnishEn: mint bouquet, lemon wheel or dehydrated lemon wheel

recipes.name: Banana Daiquiri
recipes.desc: 热带酒吧里很常见，常以预调mix出售，打成奶昔版的经典 Daiquiri……
steps: 1. 所有材料放入搅拌机打至顺滑
2. 倒入冰镇杯中，装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Put all of the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth.
2. Pour into the chilled glass, and garnish.
recipes.descEn: Popular at tropical bars and often sold in prefabricated mixes, blended versions of the classic Daiquiri…
recipes.garnishEn: Three pieces of banana-shaped hard candy (optional)

recipes.name: Barbacoa
recipes.desc: Barbacoa 是一款梅斯卡尔鸡尾酒，把新鲜姜糖浆与柠檬汁同彩椒一起捣压。
steps: 1. 摇壶中所有材料混合捣压
2. 加冰摇至冷
3. 倒入双份古典杯
4. 以一片牛肉干装饰。
stepsEn: 1. In a cocktail shaker, combine all the ingredients and muddle them together.
2. Add ice and shake until chilled.
3. Pour into a double Old-Fashioned glass.
4. Garnish with a piece of beef jerky.
recipes.descEn: The Barbacoa is a mezcal cocktail recipe that muddles fresh ginger syrup and lemon juice with bell peppers…

recipes.name: Barmuda Triangle
steps: 1. 用 pebble ice 摇匀
2. 滤入鸡尾酒杯
3. 装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Shake with pebble ice.
2. Strain into a cocktail glass.
3. Garnish.

recipes.name: Barracuda
recipes.desc: 一款明快金黄的朗姆鸡尾酒。
steps: 1. 除普罗塞克外所有材料入摇壶
2. 加冰充分摇匀
3. 滤入装冰的高球杯
4. 补满普罗塞克
stepsEn: 1. Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker except the Prosecco
2. Shake well with ice
3. Strain into chilled highball glass filled with ice
4. Top up with Prosecco
recipes.descEn: The Barracuda cocktail is a bright yellow Rum cocktail.
recipes.garnishEn: Pineapple and Cherry, optional mint sprig for additional aroma.

recipes.name: Basil Julep
recipes.desc: 选一款个性鲜明的爱尔兰威士忌——带浓郁油润香料气息，能压住罗勒的挥发……
steps: 1. 在朱莉普杯中用胶树糖浆捣压 2-3 片罗勒叶
2. 填满碎冰并加入威士忌
3. 搅拌至冷且结霜，再补碎冰
stepsEn: 1. Muddle 2-3 basil leaves with gum syrup in a julep cup
2. Fill with crushed ice and add whiskey
3. Stir until cold and frosty, then top with more crushed ice
recipes.descEn: Pick a high-character Irish Whiskey - something with rich, oily spice notes to pull down the basil's volatile…

recipes.name: Batanga
recipes.desc: 1960 年代由唐·哈维尔·德尔加多·科罗纳在龙舌兰镇的 La Capilla 酒吧首创。
steps: 1. 所有材料放入装冰的高球杯
2. 搅拌均匀
stepsEn: 1. Combine all of the ingredients in a highball glass with ice.
2. Stir to combine.
recipes.descEn: First created at a bar called La Capilla in the town of Tequila by Don Javier Delgado Corona in the 1960s,…

recipes.name: Bay Ridge
recipes.desc: Bay Ridge 约 2014 年诞生于布鲁克林鸡尾酒廊 Clover Club，代表了一条悠久的……
steps: 1. 除装饰外所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯
2. 搅拌 15–20 秒至充分冰镇
3. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯或尼格诺拉杯，以橙皮 twists 装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients except garnish in a mixing glass filled with ice.
2. Stir for 15–20 seconds until well chilled.
3. Strain into chilled coupe or Nick & Nora glass, and garnish with an orange twist.
recipes.descEn: The Bay Ridge, which originated at Brooklyn cocktail lounge Clover Club around 2014, represents a long line…

recipes.name: Bebbo
recipes.desc: Bebbo 是一款改编自经典 Bee's Knees 的鸡尾酒。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰摇至充分冰镇
3. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯，用一道安高天娜苦精装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
2. Add ice and shake until well-chilled.
3. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a stripe of Angostura bitters.
recipes.descEn: The Bebbo is a cocktail recipe that riffs on the classic Bee’s Knees.

recipes.name: Bee Sting
recipes.desc: 苏格兰威士忌、蜂蜜与草本利口酒在这杯来自调酒师 Jonathan Pogash 的非常规酒中相遇。
steps: 1. Bärenjäger、Laphroaig、Fernet-Branca、蛋清与橘子汁入摇壶，用力干摇（不加冰）
2. 填满冰后再摇至充分冰镇
3. 双滤入装新鲜冰块的古典杯
4. 补入苦精。
stepsEn: 1. Add the Bärenjäger, Laphroaig, Fernet-Branca, egg white and tangerine juice into a shaker and vigorously dry-shake (without ice).
2. Fill with ice and shake again until well-chilled.
3. Double-strain into an Old Fashioned glass filled with fresh ice.
4. Top with the bitters.
recipes.descEn: Scotch, honey and herbal liqueurs come together in this unconventional drink from bartender Jonathan Pogash.

recipes.name: Beet It
recipes.desc: 圣迭戈 Books & Records 饮品总监 Chris D'Apice 说，这杯梅斯卡尔甜菜鸡尾酒……
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰充分摇匀后滤出
3. 不加冰倒入浅碟杯或马天尼杯
4. 滴入几滴橄榄油。
**注：** 任何预装甜菜汁都比不上现榨的甜菜。家里没有榨汁机的话，最好去本地鲜榨汁店榨一批。16 盎司外带杯能调 16 杯。天然食品店也有不错的瓶装甜菜汁，但通常会加柠檬汁和柠檬酸作防腐剂，那样的话要减少青柠汁用量以保持平衡。
stepsEn: 1. Pour all of the ingredients into a shaker.
2. Add ice, give it a good shake and strain.
3. Serve up, into a coupe or martini glass.
4. Top with drops of olive oil.

**Note:** No prebottled beet juice will live up to freshly juiced beets. If you don't have your own juicer at home, the best option is to swing by your local fresh juice shop and have them make you a fresh batch. A 16-oz. to-go cup will make 16 cocktails. Natural grocery stores carry decent bottled beet juice, but they generally add acid in the form of lemon juice and citric acid as a preservative, in which case you can pull back on the amount of lime juice to keep the cocktail balanced.
recipes.descEn: According to Chris D'Apice, beverage director of San Diego's Books & Records, this mezcal beet cocktail…

recipes.name: Bee’s Knees
recipes.desc: 由奥地利出生的调酒师 Frank Meier 创制。
steps: 1. 蜂蜜与柠檬汁、橙汁搅至溶解
2. 加入金酒加冰摇匀
3. 滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
变体：
- 有时推荐用带蜜渍风味的 Barr Hill 金酒，也可用其他金酒替代。
- 蜂蜜可按 1:1 用温水稀释以降低黏稠度。
stepsEn: 1. Stir honey with lemon and orange juices until it dissolves
2. Add gin and shake with ice
3. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass
**Variations:**
- Barr Hill Gin is sometimes recommended for its honey infusion, though other gins may be used (including Barr Hill's Tom Cat gin).
- The honey may be diluted 1:1 with warm water to thin the consistency.
recipes.descEn: The Bee's Knees was invented by Frank Meier, an Austrian-born, part Jewish bartender who was the first head…
recipes.garnishEn: Optionally garnish with a lemon or orange zest.

recipes.name: Belleville
recipes.desc: 亚特兰大餐厅 Little Sparrow 的鸡尾酒偏经典，带点法式风情。
steps: 1. 所有材料与柠檬皮一起加冰倒入调酒杯，搅拌至冷，滤入装大冰块的杯中。以柠檬皮装饰。
2. 注：这杯用到了一种很少被利用的技法「Royal Stir」——把柠檬皮放进调酒杯，在搅拌时温柔地增添亮度与质地，却不通过挤汁去抢成品的香气。我们鼓励家庭调酒者尝试这个手法，如果你更想凸显所用烈酒本身的高品质。 ——Allison Lovelace
stepsEn: 1. Combine all of the ingredients in a mixing glass with ice and expressed lemon peel. Stir to chill, then strain over a large ice cube in the glass. Garnish with a lemon peel.

2. Note“This cocktail calls for a very under-utilized technique called the ‘Royal Stir’ where we incorporate a lemon peel in the mixing glass to gently add brightness and texture during the stir—but not getting in the way of the aromatics of the final cocktail via an expression. We encourage home bartenders to experiment with this approach if they want to highlight the high quality of the spirits that are being used rather than the citrus garnish.”—Allison Lovelace
recipes.descEn: At Atlanta bistro Little Sparrow, the cocktails skew classic with French accents.

recipes.name: Bellini
recipes.desc: 1934 至 1948 年间由 Harry's Bar 创始人 Giuseppe Cipriani 创制。
steps: 1. 桃泥加冰倒入调酒杯
2. 加入普罗塞克
3. 轻搅后倒入冰镇长笛杯
stepsEn: 1. Pour peach puree into the mixing glass with ice
2. Add the Prosecco wine.
3. Stir gently and pour in a chilled flute glass.
recipes.descEn: The Bellini was invented sometime between 1934 and 1948 by Giuseppe Cipriani, founder of Harry's Bar in…

recipes.name: Benton’s Old-Fashioned
recipes.desc: 以「脂肪洗酒」概念闻名的经典做法。
steps: 1. 所有材料入调酒杯
2. 加冰搅拌至冰镇
3. 滤入装大冰块的古典杯
4. 以橙皮装饰
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a mixing glass.
2. Add ice and stir until chilled.
3. Strain into a rocks glass over ice (preferably a large cube).
4. Garnish with an orange peel.
recipes.descEn: The Benton’s Old-Fashioned cocktail recipe is the drink that introduced the concept of “fat-washing” spirits…

recipes.name: Beton
recipes.desc: Beton 是一杯捷克鸡尾酒，以草本利口酒 Becherovka 和汤力水调制。
steps: 1. 材料倒入装冰的高球杯
2. 以柠檬片装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Add ingredients to a highball glass with ice.
2. Garnish with a lemon slice.
recipes.descEn: The Beton is a Czech cocktail starring Becherovka, an herbal liqueur, and tonic water, that is sometimes…

recipes.name: Betty Carter

3. Double strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

recipes.name: Betty Is Back
recipes.desc: 以 1940 年代 Connaught Bar 首席调酒师命名，这杯起泡酒曾是……

recipes.name: Between the Sheets
recipes.desc: 通常认为由巴黎 Harry's New York Bar 的 Harry MacElhone 创制。

recipes.name: Beuser & Angus Special
recipes.desc: 来自柏林的查特酒酸酒，Beuser & Angus Special 取材于 Last Word 与 Ramos……
steps: 1. 前 5 种材料倒入摇壶，加冰用力摇匀
2. 滤入装冰的古典杯
3. 补入橙花水。
stepsEn: 1. Combine the first five ingredients in a cocktail shaker and shake hard with ice.
2. Strain into a rocks glass filled with ice.
3. Top with orange flower water.
recipes.descEn: Chartreuse sour from Berlin, the Beuser & Angus Special takes inspiration from the Last Word and the Ramos…

recipes.name: Bijou
recipes.desc: 这杯由「专业调酒之父」Harry Johnson 发明，他称之为 bijou……

stepsEn: Stir in mixing glass with ice and strain
recipes.descEn: This cocktail was invented by Harry Johnson, "the father of professional bartending", who called it bijou…

recipes.name: Bijou Blanc
recipes.desc: Bijou 的现代演绎，为这款经典查特酒鸡尾酒注入新意。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯
2. 搅拌至冷

4. 以一面「旗」状柠檬皮装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass with ice.
2. Stir until chilled.
3. Strain into a rocks glass over ice.
4. Garnish with a lemon peel “flag.”
recipes.descEn: A modern take on the Bijou, this cocktail recipe puts a fresh spin on the classic Chartreuse cocktail,…

recipes.name: Bitter Giuseppe
recipes.desc: Stephen Cole 的 Bitter Giuseppe 最早出现在芝加哥 Violet Hour 的早期菜单上。
steps: 1. 所有材料在调酒杯中加冰搅拌至冷
2. 滤入装单块大冰的古典杯并装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Stir all the ingredients together in a mixing glass with ice until chilled.
2. Strain into a rocks glass over a single large ice cube and garnish.
recipes.descEn: First featured on an early menu at the Violet Hour in Chicago, Stephen Cole's Bitter Giuseppe cocktail has…

recipes.name: Bitter Mai Tai
recipes.desc: 也许是提基经典里被改编最多的酒，Mai Tai 配方本身是……

3. 以薄荷枝装饰。

### 杏仁露：
stepsEn: 1. Combine all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake until chilled, about 10 seconds.
2. Strain into a large rocks glass over crushed ice.
3. Garnish with mint sprig.
## Editors note:
### Orgeat:
300 grams raw almonds (about 3 1⁄2 cups/ 1⁄2 pound)
recipes.descEn: Perhaps the most riffed-upon cocktail in the tiki canon, the Mai Tai cocktail recipe serves as the…

recipes.name: Black Manhattan
recipes.desc: 用 Amaro Averna 替代甜味美思的现代曼哈顿变体。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰入调酒杯搅拌至冷
2. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯
3. 以樱桃装饰
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass with ice and stir until chilled.
2. Strain into a chilled coupe.
3. Garnish with a cherry.
recipes.descEn: Amaro Averna stands in for sweet vermouth in this Manhattan-inspired modern classic cocktail recipe from Todd…

recipes.name: Black Russian
recipes.desc: 变体：白俄罗斯——在顶部浮一层鲜奶油，再缓缓拌入。
steps: 所有材料倒入装冰的古典杯，轻轻搅拌
stepsEn: Pour the ingredients into the old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.
recipes.descEn: Variations: **WHITE RUSSIAN** – Float fresh cream on the top and stir in slowly.

recipes.name: Black Walnut Old Fashioned
recipes.desc: 想要一款层次更温暖的古典改编，Walnut Old Fashioned 会合你意。
steps: 所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯，搅拌至冷，滤入装新鲜冰块的古典杯。
stepsEn: Combine ingredients in a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled. Strain into an Old Fashioned glass with fresh ice.
recipes.descEn: If you are after an Old Fashioned riff with a warming complexity then a Walnut Old Fashioned should hit the…

recipes.name: Blackberry Whiskey Smash
recipes.desc: 果味主导，又不会太甜。
steps: 1. 调酒壶中捣压黑莓、薄荷与糖浆
2. 加入柠檬汁、威士忌与冰
3. 摇至冷
4. 双滤入装碎冰的古典杯。
stepsEn: 1. Muddle berries, mint, and syrup in a mixing tin
2. Add lemon juice, whiskey and ice
3. Shake until chilled
4. Double strain over crushed ice into a rocks glass
recipes.descEn: Fruit-forward without being too sweet.

recipes.name: Blackthorn
recipes.desc: Blackthorn 的渊源可追溯到 19 世纪的新奥尔良，是少数……
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰搅拌，滤入装新鲜冰块的杯中，装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Stir all of the ingredients with ice, then strain into a glass filled with fresh ice, and garnish.
recipes.descEn: With roots dating back to 19th-century New Orleans, the Blackthorn cocktail is one of the few classics to…

recipes.name: Blinker
recipes.desc: 用整整一盎司红石榴糖浆来平衡西柚汁与黑麦基酒。

3. 西柚皮挤出精油后投入杯中
stepsEn: 1. Combine all the ingredients except the grapefruit twist in a cocktail shaker filled with ice and shake until chilled, about 15 seconds.
2. Strain into a chilled coupe.
3. Twist a piece of grapefruit zest over the drink and drop into the glass.
recipes.descEn: Calling on a full ounce of grenadine to complement the grapefruit juice and rye base, this cocktail recipe is…

recipes.name: Blood and Sand
recipes.desc: 格外顺滑的经典款，可选带烟熏收尾。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰摇匀
2. 滤入浅碟杯
3. 炙烤橙皮后装饰
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients with ice and shake
2. Strain into a coupe
3. Flame orange peel and garnish
recipes.descEn: An exceptionally smooth classic with an optional smoky finish

recipes.name: Blood Moon
recipes.desc: Blood Moon 只是 Joe Campanale 向开胃酒致敬的其中一个例子，出现在 Alta……
steps: 1. 在装冰的葡萄酒杯中直接兑制，以半月形橙片装饰。

recipes.descEn: The Blood Moon cocktail recipe is just one example of Joe Campanale's ode to aperitivo, on the menu at Alta…

recipes.name: Bloody Caesar
recipes.desc: Bloody Caesar 是在 Bloody Mary 基础上加蛤蜊汁的改编。
steps: 1. 高杯杯口蘸芹菜盐，填满冰备用
2. 伏特加、Clamato 汁、辣酱油、Tabasco 与辣根酱加冰倒入调酒杯
3. 在两个调酒杯之间来回倒几次使其融合
4. 滤入备好的杯中
5. 以芹菜、黄瓜条和青柠角装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Coat the rim of a tall glass with celery salt, fill with ice and set aside.
2. Add the vodka, Clamato juice, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco and horseradish into a mixing glass with ice.
3. Pour back and forth into another mixing glass a few times to combine.
4. Strain into the prepared glass.
5. Garnish with a celery stalk, cucumber spear and lime wedge.
recipes.descEn: The Bloody Caesar is a clam-juice-spiked riff on the Bloody Mary.

recipes.name: Bloody Mary
recipes.desc: 如客人要求加冰，则倒入高球杯。

stepsEn: Stir gently all the ingredients in a mixing glass with ice, pour into rocks glass.
recipes.descEn: If requested served with ice, pour into highball glass.

recipes.desc: 「Bloom No. 5 的目标是……
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰入摇壶，用力摇匀
2. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯
3. 挤出柠檬皮精油并作装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all of the ingredients in a shaker with ice and shake vigorously.

recipes.name: Blue Hawaii
recipes.desc: 改编自 Harry K. 在 1957 年创作的配方。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入调酒壶
2. 加 4 盎司碎冰快速搅打 4-5 秒
3. 倒入装 8 盎司碎冰的飓风杯
4. 以菠萝片、菠萝叶与兰花装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a shaker tin.
2. Flash-blend for 4 to 5 seconds with 4 ounces of crushed ice.
3. Pour into a hurricane glass over 8 ounces of crushed ice.
4. Garnish with sliced pineapple, pineapple fronds and an orchid.
recipes.descEn: Adapted from a recipe created in 1957 by Harry K.

recipes.name: Bluebird Eggnog
recipes.desc: 巴尔的摩 The Bluebird 的这杯蛋酒 combines 奶油、朗姆、苹果白兰地、一颗蛋……
recipes.garnish: 白巧克力蛋壳（见编者注）
steps: 1. 所有材料入摇壶用力干摇
2. 加冰后快速用力摇匀

### 白巧克力蛋壳
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a shaker and dry-shake vigorously.
2. Add ice, and quickly hard-shake.
3. Double-strain into a rocks glass with light ice.
4. To garnish, place a white chocolate eggshell on top of the cocktail.

### White Chocolate Eggshell

recipes.name: Bon Soirée

3. Shake to chill, then strain into the prepared glass.

recipes.name: Boothby
recipes.desc: Boothby 证明了改造经典鸡尾酒是件常做常新的事，它是禁酒令之前的……

recipes.descEn: Proof that tinkering with classic cocktails is an evergreen endeavor, the Boothby is a pre-Prohibition…

recipes.name: Boozy Shakerato
recipes.desc: 餐后提神或早晨叫醒都合适，这杯 boozy shakerato 用途很广……
steps: 1. 基础糖浆、浓缩咖啡与柠檬利口酒（或桑布卡、杏仁利口酒）倒入摇壶并加满冰。用力摇打至酒体完全充气、蓬松。滤入餐后酒杯。
stepsEn: 1. Combine the simple syrup, espresso and your choice of either limoncello, sambuca, or amaretto in shaker and fill with ice. Shake vigorously to create a fully aerated, fluffy drink. Strain into an after-dinner glass.

recipes.name: Boulevardier
recipes.desc: 与尼格罗尼同源，三味中占了两味。
steps: 所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯，充分搅拌后滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
stepsEn: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: The boulevardier is similar to a Negroni, sharing two of its three ingredients.
recipes.garnishEn: Garnish with orange zest, optionally a lemon zest.

recipes.name: Bourbon Lift
recipes.desc: 相当于鸡尾酒版的纽约蛋奶，这杯浓郁带气泡的波本酒非常好喝。
steps: 1. 波本、咖啡利口酒、淡奶油与杏仁露入摇壶，不加冰干摇 10 秒。加冰再摇至充分冰镇。
2. 滤入柯林杯。
3. 从约 6 英寸高处补入苏打水。
4. 等几秒再补一点苏打水，这样泡沫会被顶到杯口之上。
5. 配吸管上桌。
stepsEn: 1. Add the bourbon, coffee liqueur, heavy cream and orgeat into a shaker and vigorously dry-shake (without ice) for 10 seconds. Add ice and shake again until well-chilled.
2. Strain into a Collins glass.
3. Fill with the club soda, pouring from about 6 inches above the glass.
4. Wait a few seconds and then add another splash of soda. This will lift the foam above the top of the glass.
5. Serve with a straw.
recipes.descEn: The cocktail equivalent of a New York egg cream, this rich and fizzy bourbon drink is absolutely delicious.

recipes.name: Bourbon Renewal
recipes.desc: 这杯是以我的合伙人 Tony Figoli 很久以前待过的一个乐队命名的。
recipes.garnish: 以柠檬角装饰，时令合适时也可用新鲜红醋栗
steps: 1. 材料加冰摇至冷
2. 滤入装新鲜冰块的古典杯
3. 以柠檬角装饰，时令合适时也可用新鲜红醋栗。
stepsEn: 1. Shake ingredients with ice until cold.
2. Strain over fresh ice into an old-fashioned glass.
3. Garnish with a lemon wedge, or if in season, fresh currants.
recipes.descEn: This one was named after a band that my business partner, Tony Figoli was in a long time ago.

recipes.name: Bourbon Stone Sour

steps: 1. 波本、鲜榨橙汁、鲜榨柠檬汁与基础糖浆倒入摇壶
2. 加冰摇至冷
3. 滤入装新鲜冰块的鸡尾酒杯。
stepsEn: 1. Combine bourbon, fresh orange juice, fresh lemon juice, and simple syrup in a cocktail shaker.
2. Add ice and shake until chilled.
3. Strain into a cocktail glass over fresh ice.

recipes.name: Brainstorm

2. Twist an orange peel over the cocktail and use as garnish.
recipes.descEn: This classic Irish whiskey cocktail from Hugo Ensslin’s 1917 Recipes for Mixed Drinks has been adapted for…

recipes.name: Bramble
recipes.desc: 1984 年由 Dick Bradsell 在伦敦创制。
steps: 1. 除黑莓利口酒外所有材料入摇壶
2. 加冰充分摇匀
3. 滤入装碎冰的古典杯
4. 以画圈方式将黑莓利口酒淋在酒面上。
注：没有黑莓利口酒时，多数调酒师会用黑醋栗利口酒替代。
stepsEn: If crème de mûre is unavailable, many bartenders will substitute creme de cassis for it.
1. Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker except the Crème de Mûre
2. Shake well with ice
3. Strain into chilled old fashioned glass filled with crushed ice
4. Pour the blackberry liqueur (Crème de Mûre) over the top of the drink, in a circular motion.
recipes.descEn: The Bramble was created in London, in 1984, by Dick Bradsell.
recipes.garnishEn: Garnish optionally with a lemon slice and blackberries.

recipes.name: Brandy Crusta
recipes.desc: 以杯口糖霜得名，由纽约调酒师 Joseph Santini 创制。
recipes.garnish: 橙（或柠檬）片沿杯口摩擦后蘸白砂糖，橙皮卷起置于杯内壁

recipes.garnishEn: Rub a slice of orange (or lemon) around the rim of the glass and dip it in pulverized white sugar, so that the sugar will adhere to the edge of the glass. Carefully curling place the orange/lemon peel around the inside of the glass.

recipes.name: Brasserie Special
recipes.desc: 带上这杯百香果酸酒，把威士忌带到岛上。

3. 滤入冰镇浅碟杯

2. Add ice and shake hard for 20 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled coupe

recipes.name: Breakfast Margarita

3. Garnish.

3. 刨些橙皮撒在酒面上作装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Stir the marmalade with the lemon juice at the bottom of a cocktail shaker until it dissolves.
2. Add the gin and Curaçao. Shake with ice. Fine strain into a chilled cocktail coupe.
3. Shred some orange peel on the top of the drink as a garnish.
recipes.descEn: This cocktail recipe is one of the earliest—and still the most famous—examples of jam as an ingredient in a…

recipes.name: Bright Orchard Gin and Tonic

2. Pour in the gin, apple juice, and lemon juice.
3. Top with light tonic water.
4. Stir once to integrate.
5. Garnish with an apple slice and rosemary sprig.
recipes.descEn: A refreshing winter variation of the classic gin and tonic that combines orchard fruits, citrus, and juniper…

recipes.name: Brown Derby

3. 在酒面挤出西柚 twists 的精油并投入杯中作装饰。

2. Fine-strain into a cocktail glass.
3. Express the oil from a grapefruit twist over the drink and drop the twist into the drink to garnish.

recipes.name: Bywater
recipes.desc: Bywater 是一杯来自新奥尔良的朗姆与查特酒鸡尾酒，改编自 Brooklyn，后者本身又是……
recipes.garnish: 橙皮 twists（挤出后丢弃）、樱桃
steps: 1. 所有材料在装冰的调酒杯中搅拌至冷
2. 滤入浅碟杯或尼格诺拉杯
3. 在酒面挤出橙皮精油后丢弃，以樱桃装饰。

2. Strain into a coupe or a Nick & Nora glass.
3. Express an orange twist over the surface, then discard. Garnish with a cherry.
recipes.descEn: The Bywater is a rum and Chartreuse cocktail recipe from New Orleans that riffs on the Brooklyn, itself a…

recipes.name: Cable Car

2. Put your glass to the side and add ice to your shaker.

4. Shake cold!

recipes.name: Cafe Martini

recipes.name: Cafe Racer

stepsEn: 1. Add ingredients to a mixing glass with ice

3. Express an orange peel and garnish

recipes.name: Caipirinha

stepsEn: 1. Place lime and sugar into a double old fashioned glass and muddle gently.
2. Fill the glass with cracked ice and add Cachaça.

recipes.name: Calvados & Tonic

recipes.name: Cameron Park Spritz

recipes.name: Campari Spritz
steps: 所有材料在葡萄酒杯中直接兑入

recipes.name: Campbeltown
recipes.desc: 三种材料成就这杯完美的一口，价格不菲却无比好喝的苏格兰鸡尾酒。
steps: 1. Springbank 10 年苏格兰威士忌、Cherry Heering 利口酒与绿查特酒加冰倒入调酒杯，搅拌至充分冰镇。

recipes.name: Canchànchara

recipes.name: Cane & Table’s Royal Hawaiian

steps: 1. 若用传统陶杯上桌，使用前先在冷水中浸泡 10 分钟。否则用高球杯。

stepsEn: 1. If using the traditional clay cup for serving, soak it in cold water for 10 minutes before using. Otherwise, use a highball glass.

recipes.name: Carajillo
recipes.desc: 用一杯酒来提神咖啡，不管在哪儿都算是普遍认可的做法。
steps: 1. 每杯现煮 3 盎司浓缩咖啡，冷却至室温或冷藏以免过度稀释。在装冰的摇壶中加入冰镇浓缩咖啡与 Licor 43。充分摇至绵密起泡，滤入装新鲜冰块的杯中，装饰。
小贴士 Carajillo 既是咖啡也是鸡尾酒——现煮浓缩咖啡、用好的咖啡豆，对最终风味影响很大。

stepsEn: 1. Brew 3 oz. of espresso per drink and cool to room temperature or chill in

the fridge to prevent excess dilution. In a shaker filled with ice, add chilled espresso and Licor 43. Shake well until creamy and frothy, then strain into the glass filled with fresh ice, and garnish.
TIPThe Carajillo is as much a coffee drink as it is a cocktail—brewing the espresso fresh, and using a high-quality coffee, will have a big impact on the final flavor.
recipes.descEn: Bolstering one’s coffee with a shot of booze is more or less a universally accepted practice, regardless of…

4. 等泡沫完全消下去，再把剩余的鸡尾酒滤完。
stepsEn: 1. Add all of the ingredients except tonic water to a shaker with no ice.
2. Shake to combine, then add ice and shake well until chilled and foamy.
3. Add chilled tonic water to an empty Collins glass, then strain the cocktail into the tonic until the top of the drink is half an inch below the rim.
4. Wait for the foam to completely settle, then finish straining the remainder of the cocktail.

recipes.name: Charles Dickens’ Punch
recipes.desc: 「狄更斯是个热衷于调潘趣酒、也天生爱表演的人，」酒史家 David Wondrich 如此写道……
steps: 1. 调制前几小时，用削皮器或小刀削 4 个柠檬的皮，做成 4 条长螺旋。放入耐热碗中，加 3/4 杯德梅拉拉糖。把果皮与糖一起捣压，室温静置。把 4 个削皮柠檬（以及需要的额外柠檬）经滤网榨汁，得到 6 盎司滤汁，置冰箱备用。
2. 把朗姆与干邑量入大壶或其他倒酒容器。调制时将水烧开，把盛有柠檬皮与糖的碗放在砧板或其他耐热面上，置于开阔处（远离杂物、易燃物、窗帘或灯具），让所有人都能安全地围过来。
3. 把干邑与朗姆倒入碗中。用长柄吧勺舀起一勺朗姆干邑混合液，用火柴点燃，悬在碗面上方引燃其余液体。用吧勺或耐热汤勺搅拌帮助糖溶解。让混合物燃烧 2 到 3 分钟，期间偶尔用勺子挑起一条柠檬皮，展示火焰沿着它窜下。
4. 用大号耐热盘或托盘盖住碗灭火。加入柠檬汁与热水。（想做冷饮的话，用 3 杯冷水替换热水，并加入 1 夸脱的冰块——把一夸脱碗的水冻 24 小时即可。）搅拌。在表面磨新鲜肉豆蔻，按 3 盎司一份舀出。
stepsEn: 1. A few hours before preparing the punch, peel 4 lemons with a vegetable peeler or paring knife to create 4 long spirals of peel. Put them in a heatproof bowl with 3/4 of a cup of demerara sugar. Muddle the peels and
the sugar together and let sit at room temperature. Juice the 4 peeled lemons (and any extra needed) through a strainer to yield 6 oz. of strained juice. Set aside in the fridge.

2. Measure the rum and Cognac into a pitcher or other pouring vessel. To prepare the punch, boil the water and place the bowl containing the lemon peels and sugar on a wooden cutting board or other heat-resistant surface in an open area (free from clutter, flammable items, or nearby curtains or light fixtures) where everyone can gather around at a safe distance.

3. Pour the Cognac and rum into the bowl. Use a long-handled barspoon to remove a spoonful of the rum-cognac mixture. Light the spoonful on fire with a match and hold it just above the surface of the bowl in order to ignite the rest of the liquid. Stir with the barspoon or a heatproof ladle to help dissolve the sugar. Let the mixture burn for 2 or 3 minutes, occasionally lifting out one of the lemon peels with the ladle or spoon to show the flames running down it.

4. Cover the bowl with a large heatproof dish or tray to extinguish the flames. Add the lemon juice and the hot water. (For cold punch, replace the hot water with 3 cups of cold water and add a 1-quart block of ice, made by freezing a quart bowl of water for 24 hours.) Stir. Grate fresh nutmeg over the top and ladle out in 3-ounce servings.
recipes.descEn: “Dickens was a dedicated punch-maker and an inveterate showman,” says drinks historian David Wondrich,…

recipes.name: Chauncey

steps: 1. 所有材料在调酒杯中加冰搅拌至冷，滤入冰镇杯中并装饰。
2. Tip「我也会用白味美思试这个，因为那个年代的很多配方，比如 Algonquin、El Presidente 和 Blackthorn，都写的是干味美思——在我看来用白味美思味道更好。」——Meehan
stepsEn: 1. Stir all of the ingredients in a mixing glass with ice until chilled. Strain into a chilled glass and garnish.

4. 装饰。

2. Shake until chilled.

4. Garnish.

recipes.name: Cinder Bloom

recipes.name: Clarified New York Sour

5. 上桌时，把混合液倒在大冰块上。

2. Let sit for 30 minutes, allowing the milk to curdle.

recipes.descEn: This clarified take on the New York Sour achieves a silky mouthfeel and a softened acidity, making for an…

recipes.name: Clover Club
recipes.desc: 早于美国禁酒令的饮品，得名于纽约的社交俱乐部 Clover Club。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰充分摇匀
3. 滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
蛋清的作用不是增味，而是乳化——摇匀后能形成标志性的绵密泡沫层。
stepsEn: 1. Pour all ingredients into cocktails shaker.
2. Shake well with ice.
3. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
The egg white is not added for the purpose of giving the drink flavor, but rather acts as an emulsifier. Thus when the drink is shaken a characteristic foamy head is formed.
recipes.descEn: The Clover Club Cocktail is a drink that pre-dates Prohibition in the United States, and is named for the…

recipes.name: Clover Leaf
recipes.desc: 这份配方出自詹姆斯·比尔德奖获奖的美食史家兼记者 Toni Tipton-Martin，是一道现代……
steps: 1. Chambord 或红石榴糖浆、柠檬汁、蛋清或淡奶油与金酒加冰块倒入摇壶。
2. 用力摇 10 秒，直到材料变冷、酒体起泡并泛出粉色。
3. 滤入马天尼杯或浅碟杯，留一层薄薄泡沫与几块小冰在表面。
4. 以薄荷叶装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine the Chambord or grenadine, lemon juice, egg white or half-and-half, and gin in a cocktail shaker with ice cubes.
2. Shake vigorously for 10 seconds, until the ingredients are cold and the mix is frothy with a pink blush.
3. Strain into a Martini or coupe cocktail glass, making sure there is a thin layer of foam and a few small ice chips floating on top.
4. Garnish with the mint leaf.
recipes.descEn: This recipe from James Beard Award-winning culinary historian and journalist Toni Tipton-Martin is a modern…

recipes.name: Coffee & Cigarettes
recipes.desc: Coffee & Cigarettes 由 Thomas Waugh 创作，出现在 Death & Co. 的酒单上。
steps: 1. 材料倒入调酒杯
2. 加冰搅拌 30-40 秒
3. 滤入冰镇的高脚鸡尾酒杯
stepsEn: 1. Combine the ingredients into your mixing glass
2. Stir with ice for 30-40 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled stemmed cocktail glass
recipes.descEn: The Coffee & Cigarettes cocktail was created by Thomas Waugh and featured in the Death & Co.

recipes.name: Coffee Cocktail
recipes.desc: 很难想出比 Coffee Cocktail 更具误导性的名字了。
recipes.garnish: 以新鲜磨碎的肉豆蔻装饰
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 干摇使蛋液乳化
3. 加冰摇至冷
4. 双滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all of the ingredients in a cocktail shaker.
2. Dry shake to emulsify the egg.
3. Add ice and shake until chilled.
4. Double strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: It probably would be difficult to come up with a more misleading name for this cocktail, than Coffee Cocktail.
recipes.garnishEn: Garnish with some freshly grated nutmeg.

recipes.name: Coffee Enzoni
recipes.desc: Enzoni 是我个人的最爱之一。
steps: 1. 摇壶中捣压葡萄
2. 加入其余材料
4. 双滤入装冰的古典杯
5. 以 3 颗串起的黑葡萄装饰
stepsEn: 1. In a cocktail shaker, muddle the grapes
2. Add the remaining ingredients
3. Shake with ice for 10-12 seconds
4. Double strain over ice into an old fashioned glass
5. Garnish with 3 skewered black grapes
recipes.descEn: The Enzoni is a personal favorite of mine.

recipes.name: Coffee Julep
recipes.desc: 咖啡利口酒与德梅拉拉胶树糖浆让这杯朱莉普风味浓郁有力。
steps: 1. 在朱莉普杯中用糖浆捣压 5-10 片薄荷叶
2. 填满碎冰并加入波本与咖啡利口酒
3. 搅拌至冷且结霜，再补碎冰
4. 双掌轻拍薄荷枝挤出精油后装饰
stepsEn: 1. Muddle 5-10 mint leaves with syrup in a julep cup
2. Fill with crushed ice and add bourbon and coffee liqueur
3. Stir until cold and frosty, then top with more crushed ice
4. Smack a mint sprig between your hands to express its oils, then garnish
recipes.descEn: Coffee liqueur and Demerara Gum Syrup give this Julep a jolt of rich flavor.

recipes.name: Coffee Negroni
recipes.desc: 人们常说，没有什么比尼格罗尼更好，除了咖啡尼格罗尼。
steps: 所有材料在装冰的调酒杯中搅拌，滤入装冰的古典杯
stepsEn: Stir all ingredients in an ice-filled mixing glass, then strain into an ice-filled rocks glass
recipes.descEn: It’s commonly been said that the only thing better than a Negroni is a Coffee Negroni.

recipes.name: Comte de Sureau
recipes.desc: 名字意为「接骨木花伯爵」，这是在向 St-Germain 这款扮演……角色的利口酒致意。
steps: 加冰搅拌，滤入装冰的冰镇古典杯。
stepsEn: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled rocks glass over ice.
recipes.descEn: The name translates to count of elderflower, which is a nod to the St-Germain that acts as the floral…
recipes.garnishEn: Garnish with orange and lemon twists.

recipes.name: Conference Cocktail
recipes.desc: 提基风格眼馋古典的调制方式，于是有了 Conference 鸡尾酒。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯
2. 搅拌 20 秒，滤入装冰的冰镇古典杯。
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice
2. Stir 20 seconds and strain into a chilled rocks glass with ice.
recipes.descEn: Tiki was jealous of the Old Fashioned build, and the Conference cocktail was born.

recipes.name: Coronado Cocktail
recipes.desc: 热带百香果糖浆、椰子水与龙舌兰的组合，热带感十足。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰用力摇 10 秒
3. 滤入装碎冰的高球杯
4. 以柠檬轮装饰
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds
3. Strain into a highball glass over crushed ice
4. Garnish with a lemon wheel
recipes.descEn: The combination of Tropical Passionfruit Syrup, coconut water, and tequila has tropical written all over it.

recipes.name: Corpse Reviver №2
recipes.desc: 《 Savoy 鸡尾酒酒谱》中记载的二号还魂酒，是最常被点用的一版。
steps: 所有材料加冰入摇壶，充分摇匀后滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
stepsEn: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice. Shake well and strain in chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: The Corpse Reviver №2 as described in the Savoy Cocktail Book is the most commonly drunk of the corpse…

recipes.name: Cosa Nostra №2
recipes.desc: Smuggler's Cove 的 Dane Barca 创作的一杯美味简单的高球酒。
steps: 除姜汁汽水外所有材料加冰摇匀，滤入装碎冰的皮尔森杯。
补入姜汁汽水。
stepsEn: Shake everything except the ginger ale with ice and strain into a pilsner glass over crushed ice.
Top with the ginger ale
recipes.descEn: A delicious and simple Highball created by Dane Barca at Smuggler's Cove

recipes.name: Cosmopolitan
recipes.desc: Cosmopolitan（俗称 cosmo）是蔓越莓饮品的近亲。
steps: 所有材料加入装冰的摇壶，充分摇匀后滤入大号鸡尾酒杯
stepsEn: Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into a large cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: A cosmopolitan, or informally a cosmo, is a relative of cranberry coolers.

recipes.name: Countermand
recipes.desc: 纽约 Somssi 餐厅出品的迷你反向马天尼。
recipes.garnish: 挤出汁水后丢弃的柠檬皮
steps: 1. 所有材料放入冰镇小杯，配一块大冰
2. 短暂搅拌，在酒面上挤出柠檬油后丢弃柠檬片

ings.note: Somssi uses a 50/50 blend of Noilly Prat Extra Dry and Cocchi Americano Bianco

stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a chilled, petite glass with one large ice cube.
2. Stir briefly, then express a lemon coin over the drink and discard.
recipes.descEn: The Countermand is a mini reverse Martini cocktail recipe served at the NYC restaurant Somssi.

recipes.name: Creole Gimlet
recipes.desc: Falernum 带来加勒比海岛风味的暗示，让经典 Gimlet 多一份好喝。
steps: 1. 所有材料入摇壶摇匀
2. 双滤入冰镇浅碟杯
3. 以青柠轮装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a shaker and shake.
2. Double strain into a chilled Coupe glass.
3. Garnish with lime wheel.
recipes.descEn: Falernum adds hints of Caribbean Island flavors for a tasty twist on the classic Gimlet.

recipes.name: Cuba Libre
recipes.desc: 20 世纪初诞生于古巴。
steps: 所有材料直接兑入装满冰的高球杯
stepsEn: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
recipes.descEn: The cocktail originated in the early 20th century in Cuba, after the country won independence in the…

recipes.name: Cucumber Gimlet
steps: 所有材料加冰摇匀，倒入装碎冰的古典杯，以卷起的黄瓜片装饰。
stepsEn: Combine all ingredients and shake with ice. Serve in a rocks glass over crushed ice. Garnish with a rolled cucumber slice.

recipes.name: Cynar Flip
recipes.desc: Cynar 在节日酒单上的绝妙应用。
steps: 1. 整颗鸡蛋在摇壶中干摇
2. 加入 Cynar、基础糖浆与冰，再摇一次
3. 滤入鸡尾酒杯，在泡沫中滴入几滴苦精
stepsEn: 1. Dry shake the whole egg in a cocktail shaker
2. Add Cynar, simple syrup, and ice before shaking again
3. Strain into a cocktail glass and drop several dashes of the bitters into the foam
recipes.descEn: A magnificent application of Cynar in the holiday canon

recipes.name: Daiquiri
recipes.desc: Daiquirí 既是哈瓦那附近的海滩名，也是铁矿名，词源自泰诺语。
steps: 1. 所有材料加入摇壶
2. 充分搅拌使糖溶解
3. 加冰摇匀
4. 滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯
stepsEn: 1. In a cocktail shaker add all ingredients.
2. Stir well to dissolve the sugar.
3. Add ice and shake.
4. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
recipes.descEn: Daiquirí is also the name of a beach and an iron mine near Santiago de Cuba, and is a word of Taíno origin.

recipes.name: Daiquiri #4
recipes.desc: 来自 Cafe La Trova 的冰沙 Daiquiri，也叫 Hemingway Daiquiri，以作者……命名。
steps: 1. 所有材料加一勺碎冰搅打 15 秒
2. 倒入 8.5 盎司浅碟杯
3. 配吸管上桌。
stepsEn: 1. Blend all ingredients with a scoop of crushed ice for 15 seconds.
2. Pour into an 8 1/2-ounce coupe glass.
3. Serve with straws.
recipes.descEn: A frozen Daiquiri cocktail recipe from Cafe La Trova, also known as the Hemingway Daiquiri, after the author…

recipes.name: Dante’s Garibaldi
recipes.desc: Dante 的招牌酒，以意大利革命家 Giuseppe Garibaldi 命名，他是……的核心人物。
steps: 1. 在装满冰的小号高球杯中兑入金巴利与橙汁
2. 搅拌，以橙角装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Build the Campari and orange juice in a small highball glass filled with ice.
2. Stir and garnish with the orange wedge.
recipes.descEn: The flagship drink at Dante is named after Italian revolutionary Giuseppe Garibaldi, who was a central figure…

recipes.name: Dark ‘n’ stormy
recipes.desc: 与莫斯科骡子很像，只是用黑朗姆替代了伏特加。
steps: 高球杯装冰倒入姜汁啤酒，再把朗姆酒浮在表面。
stepsEn: In a highball glass filled with ice pour the ginger beer and top floating with the Rum.
recipes.descEn: This drink is very similar to the Moscow mule except that the Dark 'n' Stormy has dark rum instead of vodka.
recipes.garnishEn: Garnish with a lime wedge or slice.

recipes.name: Day-O’ Fashioned
recipes.desc: Day-O' Fashioned 是用黑麦威士忌、朗姆、香蕉利口酒调制的热带古典。
steps: 1. 在古典杯中用苦精捣压橙皮
2. 加入其余材料与冰，轻搅至充分冰镇
3. 以橙片与黑樱桃装饰。

ings.note: such as Worthy Park 109 Dark Jamaican Rum
such as Giffard Banane du Brasil

stepsEn: 1. In a rocks glass, muddle the orange peel with the bitters.
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and ice, and stir gently until well-chilled.
3. Garnish with an orange slice and a black cherry.
recipes.descEn: The Day-O’ Fashioned is a tropical Old-Fashioned cocktail recipe made with rye whiskey, rum, banana liqueur,…

recipes.name: Dead Man's Handle
recipes.desc: 休斯顿 Miss Carousel 的 Tiffany Kirk 调制的夏日龙舌兰酒，用 Aperol……提了神。
steps: 混合后加冰摇匀。表面撒一层 Tajín 调味粉。
stepsEn: Combine, Shake with Ice. Top with a sprinkle of Tajín seasoning.
recipes.descEn: This summery tequila cocktail from Tiffany Kirk at Miss Carousel in Houston gets punched up with Aperol and…

recipes.name: Dead Sea Mule
recipes.desc: 自制石榴石榴糖浆是 Dead Sea Mule 的关键，这是一款梅斯卡尔版……的经典骡子。
steps: 1. 柯林杯装满冰，加入梅斯卡尔、青柠汁与石榴糖浆
2. 补入姜汁啤酒，轻柔搅匀
3. 以薄荷枝与 2 串糖渍姜装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Fill a Collins glass with ice, then add the mezcal, lime juice and grenadine.
2. Top with the ginger beer and stir briefly and gently to combine.
3. Garnish with the mint sprig and 2 skewered pieces of candied ginger.
recipes.descEn: A house-made pomegranate grenadine is the key to the Dead Sea Mule, a mezcal-laced twist on the classic…

recipes.name: Death Flip
recipes.desc: 2010 年这杯酒第一次出现在墨尔本 Black Pearl 的酒单上时，没有任何材料是……
recipes.garnish: 以新鲜磨碎的肉豆蔻装饰
steps: 1. 所有材料在调酒壶中加冰摇匀，滤入酸酒杯。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing tin and shake with ice. Strain into a sour glass.
recipes.descEn: When this cocktail first appeared on the menu at the Black Pearl in Melbourne, in 2010, no ingredients were…

recipes.name: Debbie, Don't
recipes.desc: 给那些酒柜不太齐全的人的冒险现代派鸡尾酒。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰摇匀
2. 滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯，不加冰上桌
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients over ice and shake
2. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, serve up
recipes.descEn: An adventurous modern cocktail for those with a limited bar

recipes.name: Deep South
recipes.desc: 我们的桃子糖浆，配上梅斯卡尔与黑麦威士忌的双基酒，给这杯威士忌酸酒添上夏日气息。
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰用力摇 20 秒
3. 滤入冰镇古典杯
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice and shake hard for 20 seconds
3. Strain into a chilled rocks glass
recipes.descEn: Our peach syrup, with a split base of mezcal and rye whiskey, adds a summer note to this whiskey sour.

recipes.name: Delta T
recipes.desc: 这款鸡尾酒旨在突出 Variable Dunderclap 朗姆独特的奶油感与 funky 气息，由……平衡。
recipes.garnish: 糖渍姜、青柠皮、新鲜薄荷束
steps: 1. 除姜汁啤酒外所有材料倒入调酒壶。
2. 加冰摇至冷。
3. 滤入装冰矛的高球杯。
4. 补入姜汁啤酒。
5. 表面淋几滴安高天娜苦精。
stepsEn: 1. Add all ingredients except ginger beer to a shaking tin.
2. Add ice and shake until chilled.
3. Strain into a highball glass over an ice spear.
4. Top with ginger beer.
5. Add several dashes of Angostura bitters on top.
recipes.descEn: A cocktail designed to highlight the unique buttery and funky notes of Variable Dunderclap rum, balanced by…
recipes.garnishEn: candied ginger, lime peel, and a fresh bunch of mint

recipes.name: Diki-Diki
recipes.desc: 一款复活的黄金时代鸡尾酒，也是玩转 Swedish Punsch 的绝妙方式。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰摇匀
2. 滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯，不加冰上桌
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients over ice and shake
2. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, serve up
recipes.descEn: A revived golden-era cocktail and fabulous way to tinker with Swedish Punsch

recipes.name: Dirty Martini
recipes.desc: 在经典马天尼中加入橄榄盐水，咸香风味让它自成一派。
steps: 1. 选取并冰镇马天尼杯
2. 备好串起的青橄榄
3. 所有材料加冰搅拌
4. 滤入冰镇杯中
5. 以橄榄装饰
stepsEn: 1. Select and pre-chill a Martini glass.
2. Prepare garnish of skewered Green Olives.
3. Stir all ingredients with ice.
4. Strain into chilled glass.
5. Garnish with skewered olives.
recipes.descEn: The Dirty Martini is a popular cocktail that adds olive brine to the classic Martini, giving it a savory…

recipes.name: Disgruntled Mai Tai
recipes.desc: Disgruntled Mai Tai 改编自朗姆提基酒，加入 Aperol 与一瓶苦味 Underberg……
recipes.garnish: 薄荷枝、青柠角、新鲜磨碎的肉豆蔻、鸡尾酒伞
steps: 1. 除 Underberg 外所有材料倒入摇壶。
2. 不加冰短促干摇，再加几块小冰摇至冰化。
3. 倒入冰镇古典杯并补碎冰。
4. 拧开 Underberg 瓶盖、撕开纸封顶部，倒插进碎冰里。
5. 以薄荷枝、青柠角、肉豆蔻粉与鸡尾酒伞装饰。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients except for the Underberg in a cocktail shaker.
2. Briefly dry shake without ice, then add a few small ice cubes and shake until the ice has melted.
3. Pour into a chilled rocks glass and top with crushed ice.
4. Remove the cap and the top of the paper wrapper on the Underberg bottle and insert it, upside-down, into the crushed ice.
5. Garnish with a mint sprig, lime wedge, grated nutmeg and a cocktail umbrella.
recipes.descEn: The Disgruntled Mai Tai is a spin on the rum tiki drink that adds Aperol and a bottle of bitter Underberg to…
recipes.garnishEn: mint sprig, lime wedge, freshly grated nutmeg, cocktail umbrella

recipes.name: Division Bell
recipes.desc: 这是 Last Word 的简单改编：用梅斯卡尔替代金酒，用 Aperol 替代查特酒。
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰倒入摇壶，摇至冷
2. 滤入浅碟杯
3. 在酒面挤出西柚 twists 的精油后丢弃。
stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice and shake until chilled.
2. Strain into a coupe.
3. Express a grapefruit twist over the surface of the drink, then discard.
recipes.descEn: Mezcal takes the place of gin and Aperol that of Chartreuse in this simple riff on the Last Word.

recipes.name: Don Lockwood
recipes.desc: 巧克力与烟熏风的古典改编，证明对经典鸡尾酒做简单变化也能有……
steps: 1. 调酒杯中混合所有材料
2. 加冰搅拌 20-30 秒
3. 滤入装冰的古典杯
stepsEn: 1. In a mixing glass combine all ingredients
2. Stir with ice for 20-30 seconds
3. Strain over ice into an old fashioned glass
recipes.descEn: A chocolate, smoky riff on the old fashioned that proves simple variations on classic cocktails can have…

recipes.name: Don’s Mai Tai
recipes.desc: Don's Mai Tai 源自 Don the Beachcomber 的提基鸡尾酒。
recipes.garnish: 酒渍樱桃、青柠角、新鲜薄荷
steps: 1. 所有材料倒入摇壶
2. 加冰摇至冷
3. 倒入双份古典杯并补碎冰
4. 以酒渍樱桃、青柠角与薄荷束装饰。

ings.note: preferably John D Taylor's Velvet Falernum

stepsEn: 1. Combine all ingredients in a shaker.
2. Add ice and shake until chilled.
3. Dump into a double rocks glass and top with crushed ice.
4. Garnish with a brandied cherry, lime wedge and mint bouquet.
recipes.descEn: Don’s Mai Tai is a tiki cocktail recipe originally from Don the Beachcomber.
recipes.garnishEn: brandied cherry, lime wedge, fresh mint

recipes.name: Doubleplusgood
recipes.desc: Doubleplusgood 是波士顿调酒师 John Gertsen 把 Mai Tai 与 Pisco Sour 杂交的版本。
recipes.garnish: 两个加号，用苦精在泡沫上画出来
steps: 所有材料（苦精除外）先不加冰干摇，再加冰摇一次。用细滤网双滤入冰镇矮杯，不加冰。把苦精滴在泡沫上，画成两个加号。
stepsEn: Dry-shake all ingredients (except the bitters) first without ice, then again with ice added. Double-strain through a fine mesh strainer into a chilled short glass, no ice. Drop the bitters atop the foam in the shape of two plus symbols.
recipes.descEn: Doubleplusgood is Boston barman John Gertsen’s take on a Mai Tai, crossed with a Pisco Sour.
recipes.garnishEn: two plus signs, drawn in the foam with aromatic bitters

recipes.name: Dreamy Dorini Smoking Martini
recipes.desc: Audrey Saunders 的这杯伏特加马天尼改编绝不普通，用了泥煤单一麦芽苏格兰威士忌与……
steps: 1. 所有材料加冰倒入调酒杯，搅拌至充分冰镇
2. 滤入鸡尾酒杯
3. 在酒面挤出柠檬 twists 的精油，并以 twists 装饰。

stepsEn: 1. Place the pickled onion wedge in a chilled Nick & Nora glass. In a mixing glass, stir all of the ingredients with ice, then strain into the prepared glass.

2. Pickled Spring OnionsThoroughly wash a bunch of spring onions, and use a knife to remove all of the green parts. Cut the onions into wedges, maintaining the root end (to hold the onion together). Pack the onions into a sanitized canning jar or a large food-safe plastic storage container.

3. In a pot, combine a mixture of 60 percent water and 40 percent champagne vinegar (the quantity will depend on the size of the batch you’re preparing). Weigh this liquid mixture and add 5 percent of its weight in sugar, and 3 percent of its weight in salt. Add several bay leaves, 1 Tbsp. of black peppercorns, and 1 Tbsp. of coriander seeds, and bring the mixture to a boil, whisking to dissolve the sugar.
4. Once the mixture is boiling, remove it from the heat and pour it over the onions, to cover. Cover the container and let it cool; will keep refrigerated for up to 1 month.

### Grenadine:
Combine equal parts pomegranate juice with granulated sugar in a saucepan, over low heat. Whisk until dissolved. Place in airtight container and keep in refrigerator for up to one week.

2. Stir to chill the glass, then drain off any water.
3. Pour the tea, St-Germain and whiskey into the glass and stir gently to combine.
4. Pour soda water down the side of the glass so as to retain carbonation.
5. Add ice and top with a final splash of soda water.
6. Express the lemon peel, then discard.

6. Shake two ounces of cream in a cocktail shaker until thick but pourable and carefully pour on top of the drink.

Transfer to bowl or storage container, cover, and refrigerate until well chilled, at least 1 hour or up to 4 days.
